create_tsv_iterator: create a TSV object to iterate over tab-separated rows from a file with custom delimiters
create_tsv_datasource: create a TSVDataSource to load train, test, and eval TSV files with configurable field names and delimiters
create_multilingual_tsv_datasource: create a MultilingualTSVDataSource to load multi-lingual TSV data with language columns mapped per split
create_block_sharded_tsv: create a BlockShardedTSV to iterate over a byte-range shard of a large TSV file for distributed training
create_session_tsv_datasource: create a SessionTSVDataSource to load session-based TSV data where the first column is the session id
